date_scope_check.qualification_retained: May 12 operation is supported by AFP reporting a COGAT statement and Xinhua reporting Palestinian coordinator Raed Fatouh. OCHA documents exceptions for specific international travellers and power-plant fuel; these must not be represented as a total halt. Exact exception dates and quantities remain unquantified. The interval includes the May 7–9 Memorial/Independence holiday overlap, so it is not eight days of active fighting. Underlying access restrictions continued.
